label: Discord
description: Servers, channels, messages — through a bot

sensitivePaths.label: Delete a message or a channel

agentGuide: The bot: GET /users/@me; its servers: GET /users/@me/guilds (id, name); channels of one: GET /guilds/<guild id>/channels (type 0 = text, 2 = voice, 4 = category). Read: GET /channels/<id>/messages?limit=20 (newest first; author.username, content, timestamp, attachments[].url); one: GET /channels/<id>/messages/<id>. Reading content needs the Message Content intent on the bot. Write: POST /channels/<id>/messages {"content": "..."} (reply: add "message_reference": {"message_id": "..."}; embeds: [{"title": "...", "description": "..."}]); react: PUT /channels/<id>/messages/<id>/reactions/<emoji url-encoded>/@me. Direct message: POST /users/@me/channels {"recipient_id": "<user id>"} then post to the returned channel. Members: GET /guilds/<id>/members?limit=100; roles: GET /guilds/<id>/roles. Markdown works in content; 2000 characters max per message. Respect the rate limits (429 with retry_after). The token is set by Allkin.
